decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 17/3/05, the single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse measuring 3.189m projection, 2.67m wide and 3.313m high with a flat roof and the conservatory extension measuring 3.0m deep, 3.15m wide with a height of 2.2m at eaves rising to 3.0m at ridge, was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and therefore requires planning permission for the following reason: 

The developments, when taken together with the existing porch extension, result in a volume increase exceeds the total permitted development limit for an end of terrace property given in the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of part single storey rear extension and conservatory extension to rear of house.
